name: 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA to H2O
summary: A 4-step route from 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA(4−) to H2O, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: aureothin polyketide synthase system
reactions.equation: 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA + 4 (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA + 4 NADPH + 8 H(+) = demethylluteothin + 5 CO2 + 4 NADP(+) + 6 CoA + 3 H2O

reactions.name: luteothin monooxygenase
reactions.equation: luteothin + 4 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 O2 + 4 H(+) = aureothin + 4 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 3 H2O

reactions.name: N(6),N(6)-dimethyl-L-lysyl(37)-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(6),N(6),N(6)-...
reactions.equation: N(6),N(6)-dimethyl-L-lysyl(37)-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysyl(37)-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: L-lysyl(8)-[histone H2AZ] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(6)-methyl-L-lysyl(8)-[histone H...
reactions.equation: L-lysyl(8)-[histone H2AZ] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(6)-methyl-L-lysyl(8)-[histone H2AZ] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: spectinabilin polyketide synthase system
reactions.equation: 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA + 6 (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA + 6 NADPH + 12 H(+) = demethyldeoxyspectinabilin + 7 CO2 + 6 NADP(+) + 8 CoA + 5 H2O

reactions.name: phthioceranic/hydroxyphthioceranic acid synthase
reactions.equation: hexadecanoyl-[(hydroxy)phthioceranic acid synthase] + 7 (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + 14 NADPH + 21 H(+) = C37-phthioceranyl-[(hydroxy)phthioceranic acid synthase] + 7 CO2 + 14 NADP(+) + 7 CoA + 7 H2O

reactions.name: neocarzinostatin naphthoate synthase
reactions.equation: 5 malonyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA + 2 NADPH + 6 H(+) = 2-hydroxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoate + 5 CO2 + 2 NADP(+) + 6 CoA + 3 H2O

reactions.name: N(1)-methylpseudouridine(1191) in yeast 18S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(1)-methy...
reactions.equation: N(1)-methylpseudouridine(1191) in yeast 18S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(1)-methyl-N(3)-[(3S)-3-amino-3-carboxypropyl]pseudouridine(1191) in yeast 18S rRNA + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + H(+)
